Manages and facilitates project budget planning and execution to support each step in development. Establishes evaluation criteria, and measurements to assess projects on an ongoing basis.

Exercises responsibility for the administration and management of the entire project including the facilitation and control of project planning, programming, budgeting, site selection and acquisition, appraisal, design and construction, contract evaluation, technical contract administration, etc.

Identifies, manages, integrates and/or adapts resources to achieve project goals while effectively managing scope, schedule and budget for assigned projects. Manages customer expectations and aligns customer requirements with Public Building Services policies. Manages projects in the General Services Administration Project System (s) of record.

Prepares schedules for project completion, implementing a system for review, control, and reporting on project status and recommends which phases of the project will be performed in-house or by contract. Determines project risk and assesses project activities and resources to mitigate risk on behalf of the government.

Implements quality assurance processes to ensure all aspects of the project are handled in a professional manner, meet the agreed to customer needs, and are in compliance with all contracts let by Public Building Services, General Services Administration.

Negotiates and coordinates project plans, budget objectives and schedules with management of affected customer agencies to establish and/or manage customer expectations. Informs customer officials of project status and any requirements for additional agency initiated action.

Monitors action in support of project plans and schedules and reports deviations and problems to appropriate General Services Administration and other agency officials.
To evaluate your qualifications, your resume must clearly demonstrate how you meet the specialized experience described below. Your resume must not exceed two pages.

To ensure your qualifications can be fully evaluated, we recommend including the following information: Name, address, telephone number, email address; Job Title (if Federal Service, provide series and grade; if not in GS plan, provide GS equivalent grade); Relevant work experience—should include employer name, job title, start and end dates (month/year), the number of hours worked per week and descriptions that explain how you meet the required qualifications in the job announcement.

Education, certifications or licensures—If the job announcement requires any education, certifications or licensures, make sure to include the required information and any required documents like transcripts.

Your resume should contain enough information to make a valid determination that you fully meet experience requirements for each grade level you are applying to. If you do not provide enough information for us to determine your qualifications, you may be rated ineligible.

If you have volunteered your service through a National Service program (e.g., Peace Corps, Americorps), we encourage you to apply and include this experience on your resume. The GS-12 salary range starts at $89,508 per year.

If you are a new federal employee, your starting salary will likely be set at the Step 1 of the grade for which you are selected. To qualify, you must have at least one year of specialized experience equivalent to the GS-11 level or higher in the Federal service.

Specialized experience is defined as experience utilizing project management practices and tools to simultaneously manage multiple construction and/or repair and alteration projects in a real estate environment.

This experience must include: Managing projects (balancing scope/quality, schedule and budget) requiring the services of multiple disciplines (i.e., construction, design, IT, telecommunications, interior furnishings, etc.) from project initiation phase through financial closeout; Interpreting customer needs and developing them into actionable requirements; Developing, managing, and balancing project plans, budgets, and schedules; and Coordinating and facilitating decisions by managing multiple stakeholders.

Provides high level professional, administrative and technical resources in the areas of design, construction, and complex project management programs and projects.

Advises the Assistant Commissioner (AC) and Deputy Assistant Commissioner (DAC) on important matters relating to the design, construction and all relevant OPPM programs, activities and initiatives managed by the Division.

Serves as a Senior Program Manager and provides expert leadership, analysis, guidance, technical direction and management coordination for PBS Projects.

Plans work to be accomplished by subordinates, sets and adjusts short-term priorities and prepares schedules for completion of work; assigns work based on priorities Establishes high level partnerships with stakeholders and others and is responsible for justifying, defending, influencing, negotiating and informing senior management officials
For each job on your resume, provide: the exact dates you held each job (from month/year to month/year) number of hours per week you worked (if part time). If you have volunteered your service through a National Service program (e.g., Peace Corps, Americorps), we encourage you to apply and include this experience on your resume.

The GS-15 salary range starts at $150,359 per year. To qualify, you must have at least one year of specialized experience equivalent to the GS-14 level or higher in the Federal service. Specialized experience is overseeing teams responsible for the management of projects to deliver strategic national programs or initiatives.

This experience must include: Planning, directing and advising others in applying project management policies and procedures to achieve organizational and programmatic goals, Advising diverse organizational representatives on issues involving the application or tailoring of program management methods and procedures, and Working on complex national programs or cross-agency strategic initiatives with multidisciplinary teams, and in two or more of the following program areas: Client/Stakeholder Relationships; Cost and Schedule Management Analysis for Programs; Program Management and Team Leadership; or Construction Management

You will. lead complex technology projects by defining requirements, guiding technical decisions, coordinating specialists, and resolving challenges while improving performance, reliability, productivity, and long term planning.
You will evaluate new technologies, recommend system improvements, review proposed solutions, assess technical risks, and support secure, efficient implementations that strengthen organizational operations and future readiness.
You will analyze business needs, design application solutions, oversee development, testing, documentation, and integration, while ensuring software quality, usability, security practices, and dependable performance.
You will develop strategic plans, create and update policies, prepare budgets, measure system performance, conduct program reviews, and recommend improvements that increase effectiveness, efficiency, and service quality.
You will supervise staff by assigning work, setting priorities, evaluating performance, providing coaching, supporting professional development, resolving workplace concerns, and maintaining productive, accountable teams.
You will collaborate with customers, managers, and technical specialists to address project needs, present recommendations, improve organizational processes, and support hiring, training, scheduling, and workforce planning.
Your experience must reflect skill in the following areas: attention to detail, customer service, oral communication, and problem solving. 1. Attention to Detail - Is thorough when performing work and conscientious about attending to detail.

IT-related experience demonstrating this competency include: Utilize analytical skills, evaluation techniques, and re-engineering methods to assess the technical, financial, and programmatic implications of prospective IT endeavors. 2.

Customer Service - Works with clients and customers (that is, any individuals who use or receive the services or products that your work unit produces, including the general public, individuals who work in the agency, other agencies, or organizations outside the Government) to assess their needs, provide information or assistance, resolve their problems, or satisfy their expectations; knows about available products and services; is committed to providing quality products and services.

IT-related experience demonstrating this competency include: Manage stakeholder requirements from internal/external agencies helping execute and accomplish organizational goals and objectives. 3.

Oral Communication - Expresses information (for example, ideas or facts) to individuals or groups effectively, taking into account the audience and nature of the information (for example, technical, sensitive, controversial); makes clear and convincing oral presentations; listens to others, attends to nonverbal cues, and responds appropriately.

IT-related experience demonstrating this competency include: Providing leadership, guidance, and mentorship to the workforce communicating organizational goals and objectives while aligning with the command's initiatives. 4.

Problem Solving - Identifies problems; determines accuracy and relevance of information; uses sound judgment to generate and evaluate alternatives, and to make recommendations. IT-related experience demonstrating this competency include: analysis, reporting, coordinating, and facilitating working groups to meet and resolve project objectives.

In addition: Your resume must also demonstrate at least one year of Specialized experience at or equivalent to the GS-13 grade level or NH-03 pay band in the Federal service or equivalent experience in the private or public sector. Specialized experience must demonstrate the following: 1.

Ability to effectively manage and supervise a staff of professional, technical, and/or administrative employees. 2. Mastery knowledge of and demonstrated experience in applying Information Technology principles and practices. 3. Ability to supervise and work on a diverse team engaged in Defense Acquisition program management activities. 4.

Mastery knowledge of current/emerging Congressional, regulatory, and higher headquarters directives and guidance. 5.

Mastery knowledge of any of the following functional areas: - Application Software - Customer Support - Data Management - Internet - Network Services - Operating Systems - Policy and Planning - Security - Systems Administration - Systems Analysis 6. Ability to communicate effectively both orally and in writing.

Additional qualification information can be found from the following Office of Personnel Management website: https://www.opm.gov/policy-data-oversight/classification-qualifications/competency-based-policy/general-schedule/2200/2210-competency-based-policy/competency-based-qualification-standard/ Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., professional, philanthropic, religious, spiritual, community, student, social).

Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment.

The United States Space Force (USSF) at Clear Space Force Station, Alaska is searching for a IT/Cyber COR/QA Program Manager to support 13 SWS (OBN) (NH-2210-03, GS-12/13 equivalent).

Description: Manages the Information Technology (IT)/Cyber Communications (Comm) Quality Assurance (QA) Program and performs QA evaluation and documentation of contractor performance.

Conducts inspections in Communications Operations, Computer Operations, Radar Maintenance, Computer Maintenance, Site Maintenance Management, LAN/WAN, Site Security Systems, Administrative Telephone Systems, and other assigned areas.

Determines contractor compliance with technical directives, quality, safety, timeliness, Air Force Instructions, and other contract requirements.

Develops the inspection schedule for contractor-supplied services and maintains/updates Quality Assurance Surveillance Plans (QASPs), Statements of Work (SOWs), contract modifications, inspection logs, and activity records.

Assesses policy needs and develops, approves, and interprets policy and procedures governing Information Technology (IT) and cybersecurity activities.

Serves as the Information Systems Security Manager (ISSM), establishing, maintaining, and enforcing the organization's cybersecurity program in accordance with the DoD Risk Management Framework (RMF), DoDI 8500.01, DoDI 8510.01, and applicable Air Force/Space Force cybersecurity guidance.

Interprets DoD, AF, and higher headquarters guidance and applies it locally, coordinating across organizations to develop, revise, and modify policies and assessing impacts on business requirements.

Manages the Assessment and Authorization (A&A) process, prepares and maintains system security authorization packages, and supports Authorizing Official (AO) decisions to achieve and sustain Authorizations to Operate (ATO) Provides technical expertise in the acquisition and installation of large, complex operating system environments, including personal computers, LAN servers, components, and associated software.

Independently oversees testing, migration, and cutover with minimal disruption and provides post-implementation support. Ensures appropriate configuration and sufficient system resources for new applications. Establishes project plans, priorities, and implementation schedules to ensure continuity of operations.

Evaluates operating system design requirements and consults with developers on impacts to end-user applications. Oversees hardware/software setup and configuration per the technical design plan, coordinating installation and sustainment with IT, telecommunications specialists, and the database manager.

Serves as the Contracting Officer's Representative (COR) for the installation Comm/Cyber contract, performing contract administration duties designated in the CO's Letter of Designation.

Prepares Corrective Action Reports (CARs), documents deficiencies, analyzes contractor responses for root cause and corrective actions, and performs follow-up to resolution. Reviews technical specifications, requirements, and procurement request documents; leads technical proposal reviews; and determines adequacy of vendor capability.

Serves as liaison between the Commander, Contracting Officer, contractor, Director of Mission Assurance, and other Air Force/Space Force personnel.

Coordinates with the SCIF Manager, SSO, security personnel, and Authorizing Official chain on personnel access, SCI indoctrination, cybersecurity risk, and security incidents, violations, or deviations affecting information systems and the SCIF. Participates in meetings to resolve problems, discuss procedures, and review contractor performance.

Notifies the Senior Quality Assurance Evaluator, supervisor, and Contract Quality Program Manager of deficiencies, prepares file documentation, and recommends changes to surveillance methods as warranted.

Ideal Candidate: Purpose: The purpose of this position is to support the Communications and Cyber Quality Assurance (QA) program by providing the unit commander, director, and senior leadership with a comprehensive assessment of the unit's ability to perform key logistics processes.

This is accomplished by ensuring standardized, repeatable, and technically compliant process execution, while promoting a culture of professional excellence and personal responsibility. The primary focus is on personnel proficiency and adherence to established policies and procedures.
The 2210 series has an individual occupational requirement that must be met and can be viewed here. There is no Group Coverage Qualification Standard for this series.

Develops and evaluates flight operations programs for organizations which utilize the newest, most complex aircraft systems, and equipment.

The APM is responsible for the oversight of flight operations involving large fleets (usually 30 or more) of turbine powered aircraft engaged in large-scale passenger and/or freight service for nationally and internationally prominent carriers.

Assignments at this level are of significant scope and complexity and the organizations monitored are traditionally major operators in the industry. Develops a work program to ensure periodic surveillance of designated pilot and flight engineer examiners, pilot and flight engineer check airmen, and company training programs.

Assures the assigned air carrier conducts flight crew training and testing required by appropriate Title 14 of the Code of Federal Regulations (14 CFR), FAA-approved training programs, and current testing standards. Oversees company check airmen and APDs.

Serves as the technical advisor to the Principal Operations Inspector (POI) on assigned areas of the company's training and testing programs. Coordinates technical instructions, policy orders, and procedures through the POI to assure uniformity of training and testing activities.

Responsible for conducting enforcement investigations and preparation of final reports and recommendations on disposition. Performs or supervises the emergency suspension of certificates or cancellation of operations specifications. Conducts or directs the reexamination of certificated airmen or recertification of an operator or agency.

Conducts investigations of public complaints, congressional inquiries, and aircraft incidents and accidents. Provides verbal and/or written technical assistance to legal counsel, testifies at court trials and formal hearings, and gives dispositions.

Coordinates with geographic inspectors for the accomplishment of non-routine air carrier surveillance. Recommends the designation of APDs and pilot examiners. Responsible for the conduct of flight tests, additional type ratings, and flight engineer certification; proficiency tests; initial qualification tests, and line-oriented flight training.

Assures standardization of check airmen and designated examiners and recommends to the POI any changes which are considered necessary. Monitors assigned areas of the flight crew training program and associated records to ensure compliance with pertinent 14 CFR, national and regional directives, and safe operating practices.

Monitors assigned air carrier ground and flight training. Attends certificate holder's company and safety meetings. Evaluates training programs to ensure they meet the requirements of 14 CFR. Approves or disapproves training programs including flight simulators, training devices, or other equipment used in these programs.

May require amendments to previously approved manuals to correct any conflict with regulatory requirements; eliminate unsafe practices; and/or improve the specificity of instruction.

Participates in the FAA flight program to maintain qualification and currency requirements applicable to operations inspectors, for the purpose of supporting the FAA in a variety of flight-related functions to include training and evaluation of designated pilot examiners.

Evaluates tasks contained in the FAA practical test standards and airman certification standards by participating as pilot-in-command or as a crewmember. The Inspector is required to maintain an FAA second class medical. Performs other duties as assigned.
General Requirements for All Positions: Not more than two separate incidents involving Federal aviation regulations violations in the last 5 years; Valid State driver's license; Fluency in the English language; No chemical dependencies or drug abuse that could interfere with job performance; and High school diploma or equivalent.

Medical Requirements for All Positions: Applicants must be physically able to perform the duties of the Aviation Safety Inspector position in a safe and efficient manner, and must meet all of the following requirements: Have good distant vision in each eye and be able to read printed materials the size of typewritten characters (glasses and contact lenses permitted) without strain; Have the ability to hear the conversational voice (hearing aid permitted); Not have any physical condition that would cause them to be a hazard to themselves or others or that would interfere with their ability to fly as passengers in a variety of aircraft.

In addition, applicants for positions that require participation in the operation of aircraft must: Possess a valid second-class medical certificate in accordance with Federal Aviation Agency (FAA) regulations; and Pass recurrent medical examinations as prescribed by the FAA.

Applicants not requiring valid second-class medical certificates who are tentatively selected will be required to: Provide documentation from a board-certified physician certifying that they meet the minimal medical requirements; or Individuals who do not meet the minimum medical requirements but who are otherwise qualified will receive an individualized assessment to determine whether they can perform the essential functions of the position.

When the predominant work involves air carrier operations, applicants for Aviation Safety Inspector (Operations) positions must meet all of the following requirements.

At least 1 year of pilot experience in multi-engine aircraft of more than 12,500 pounds maximum certificated takeoff weight; Not more than 2 flying accidents during the last 5 years in which the applicant's pilot error was involved; Professional flying skill as demonstrated in a simulator check to Airline Transport Pilot Standard.

Minimum 100 flight hours during the last 3 years; Airline Transport Pilot Certificate or Commercial Pilot Certificate with instrument airplane rating (Department of Navy positions require pilot experience as demonstrated by previous ATP level performance in large multi-engine airplanes and helicopters); Possession of a valid second-class FAA medical certificate (For positions within the Department of Navy, applicants must also be physically qualified to ride as an observer aboard squadron aircraft.

In addition, must also meet physical requirements to travel and lift heavy objects while performing mishap investigations); and Minimum 1,500 total flight hours. Note - Recency of specialized experience and the need for a valid second-class FAA medical certificate is waived for employees currently in the 1825 series.

To qualify for this position you must demonstrate in your application that you possess at least one year of specialized experience equivalent to FV-I, FG/GS-13 grade level. Specialized experience is experience that has equipped you with the particular knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform successfully the duties of the position.

Specialized experience includes: Provide guidance in the development of required operations manuals and record keeping systems; analyze reports to insure compliance with operations programs. Conduct enforcement investigations and preparation of final reports and recommendations on dispositions.

To assist in determining qualification requirements, applicants transferring between specialties at the same grade level are strongly encouraged to complete the appropriate Qualifications Assessment Tool (QAT) check sheet and upload it along with their resume.

Check sheets are contained in Order 3410.26, Flight Standards Service Air Carrier and General Aviation Qualifications Assessment Tool for AFS Aviation Safety Inspectors. This order is located at: https://employees.faa.gov/org/linebusiness/avs/offices/afs/tools/qat/. This Position may have oversight of multiple fleet types.

You will make strategic planning decisions affecting squadron operations while providing continuity and corporate knowledge of squadron functions and a forward-looking visionary view as to the direction of squadron work.
You will establish, and be responsible for the technical, administrative, and financial management of the squadron.
You will make decisions involving the recruiting, selection, training, evaluating, awarding and disciplining of subordinate civil service employees.
You will support special studies, initiatives, and responses to programs and data calls.
You will assess the technical progress of programs.
Your resume must demonstrate at least one year of specialized experience at or equivalent to the GS-13 grade level or pay band in the Federal service or equivalent experience in the private or public sector.

Specialized experience must demonstrate the following: 1.) Leading multi-disciplinary, cross-functional teams in the execution of complex technical operations providing strategic direction, mentoring civilian and military personnel, aligning team efforts with broader command mission objectives, and driving critical decision-making in a high-stakes operational environment. 2.) Planning, coordination, and execution of Developmental Test and Evaluation (DT&E) for aviation platforms such as formulating comprehensive test plans, managing test risk, overseeing flight test execution, and analyzing post-flight data to ensure compliance with strict safety, performance, and airworthiness standards. 3.) Forecasting, allocating, and optimizing critical resources to meet stringent mission timelines. 4.) Experience in the formulation, execution, and oversight of complex budgets. 5.) Experience building and sustaining strategic, collaborative relationships across diverse stakeholders.

Additional qualification information can be found from the following Office of Personnel Management web site: https://www.opm.gov/policy-data-oversight/classification-qualifications/general-schedule-qualification-standards/#url=List-by-Occupational-Series Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., professional, philanthropic, religious, spiritual, community, student, social).

Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment.

Salary Range: $140,000 - $190,000 Job Posting End Date: 8/1/26 We’ve Got You Under Our Wing We are the duck. We develop and empower our people, cultivate relationships, give back to our community, and celebrate every success along the way. We do it all… The Aflac Way .

Aflac , a Fortune 500 company, is an industry leader in voluntary insurance products that pay cash directly to policyholders and one of America's best-known brands. Aflac has been recognized as Fortune’s 50 Best Workplaces for Diversity and as one of World’s Most Ethical Companies by Ethisphere.com.

Our business is about being there for people in need. So, ask yourself, are you the duck? If so, there’s a home, and a flourishing career for you at Aflac . Work Designation. Depending on your location within the continental US, this role may be hybrid or remote.

If you live within 50 miles of the Aflac offices located in Columbus, GA or Columbia, SC, this role will be hybrid. This means you will be expected to work in the office for at least 60% of the work week. You will work from your home (within the continental US) for the remaining portion of the work week.

Details of this schedule will be discussed with your leadership. If you live more than 50 miles from the Aflac offices located in Columbus, GA or Columbia, SC, this role will be remote. This means you will be expected to work from your home, within the continental US.

If the role is remote, there may be occasions that you are requested to come to the office based on business need. Any requests to come to the office would be communicated with you in advance. What does it take to be successful at Aflac ?

Acting with Integrity Communicating Effectively Pursuing Self-Development Serving Customers Supporting Change Supporting Organizational Goals Working with Diverse Populations What does it take to be successful in this role?
· Strong knowledge and excellent proficiency in methodologies such as Agile, Scrum
· Ability to converse fluently with technical teams and make informed decisions about technology
· Excellent verbal and written communication skills to effectively convey ideas, updates, and feedback to various stakeholders
· Excellent analytical skills to interpret data, track program performance, and make data-driven decisions.
· Ability to think critically and solve problems creatively
· Ability to adapt to changing circumstances and pivot strategies as needed
· Extensive experience in program management and a deep understanding of technology landscapes Education & Experience Required Bachelor's Degree Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration or related field 8+ years of project management, program management, Operations/IT Management, or work-related experience Or an equivalent combination of education and experience Experience Preffered Experience with AI tools (Cloud Code, Kiro and Copilot) Principal Duties & Responsibilities
· Defining the scope, objectives, and deliverables for each program, ensuring alignment with organizational goals
· Establishing effective communication with stakeholders on program status, managing expectations, and resolving issues
· Identifying and allocating resources to maximize efficiency and effectiveness
· Identifying potential risks and developing strategies to mitigate those and continuous monitoring and adjustment of plans as needed
· Implementing performance metrics and KPIs to track program progress and reporting on these metrics to stakeholders and adjusting strategies as needed to ensure program success
· Ensuring that all projects within the program meet the required policies and standards to maintain high quality and performance
· Managing the impact of changes on the program and ensuring that changes are implemented smoothly and effectively
· Performs other duties as required Total Rewards The salary range for this job is $140,000 - $190,000. This range is specific to the job and salary offers consider a wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions, including, but not limited to: education, experience, licensure, certifications, geographic location, and peer compensation. The range has been created in good faith based on information known to Aflac at the time of the posting. At Aflac , it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for the role to allow for future and continued salary growth, and compensation decisions are dependent on the circumstances of each case. This salary range does not include any potential incentive pay or benefits, however, such information will be provided separately when appropriate. In addition to the base salary, we offer an array of benefits to meet your needs including medical, dental, and vision coverage, prescription drug coverage, health care flexible spending, dependent care flexible spending, Aflac supplemental policies (Accident, Cancer, Critical Illness and Hospital Indemnity offered at no costs to employee), 401(k) plans, annual bonuses, and an opportunity to purchase company stock. On an annual basis, you’ll also be offered 11 paid holidays, up to 20 days PTO to be used for any reason, and, if eligible, state-mandated sick leave (Washington employees accrue 1-hour sick leave for every 40 hours worked) and other leaves of absence, if eligible, when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being. Aflac complies with all applicable leave laws, including, but not limited to, sick and safe leave, and adoption and parental leave, in all states and localities. #DICE Originally posted on Himalayas

This is a remote position. Location: Remote — South Africa Note: This is a position with Haldren and not with one of its clients. About the Role We are looking for a Market Research Project Manager to own a research capability end to end, from scoping a request through to a finished, decision-ready output.

The role also involves establishing the processes, templates, and documentation this function relies on, which the successful candidate will then own and maintain. The work spans company, market, and competitive research, feeding directly into business decisions and client engagements.

Key Responsibilities Scope research requests, plan the approach, and see them through from first question to finished brief
Research and verify information on companies, sectors, and markets, across a range of business topics
Sustain ongoing tracking of relevant developments over time
Turn raw findings into clear, structured written briefs and summaries, translating facts into useful business insight
Support company, market, and competitive intelligence relevant to the firm’s core work
Maintain research files and reference materials for future use
Handle ad hoc research requests with strong accuracy and good turnaround
Help set up and refine the research function’s workflows, templates, and documentation as it takes shape
Requirements Genuine, hands-on experience in market or business research (a background in competitive intelligence, strategy/commercial research, or a related analytical field is a plus, not a substitute)
Demonstrated ability to research and verify information from multiple sources, quickly and accurately
Demonstrated ability to produce a clean, structured, decision-ready brief
Fluency with research databases, company/industry data sources, and standard spreadsheet/office tools
Strong written English and clear presentation of findings
Comfortable managing multiple research requests and shifting priorities
Able to independently scope and structure a body of research work without close supervision
Nice to Have Familiarity with professional services, recruitment, or consulting environments
Strong Excel or Google Sheets capability
Experience preparing slides, summaries, or briefing materials

· Remote work arrangement
· Opportunities for professional growth Flat management structure with direct access to decision-makers

Distribusion is the world’s leading ground transportation marketplace and gives travellers seamless access to ground transportation online, from search to ticket purchase. We have built a cutting-edge B2B technology platform that connects bus, rail, and ferry operators in 70+ countries with the biggest online retailers, including Google and Booking.com.
We are shaping the future of travel and building the largest global network of transport providers and retailers. Having grown 10x in the past year, we are one of the fastest-growing startups in travel. Backed by four leading VCs (TQ Ventures, Creandum, Northzone, and Lightrock), and now, following our recent $80 m Series C, we are ready to push beyond.
As a Senior Technical Project Manager, you will lead our most strategically important client projects in the region.

Lead pre-sales and delivery of complex API and e-commerce projects, acting as the primary point of contact for external partners, while facilitating collaboration between their teams and Distribusion’s Engineering, Product, and Operations functions.
Develop blueprint processes for the rollout of standard product offerings.
Guide product development by systematically capturing market needs and partner insights.
Workplace: Berlin/Hybrid or Europe/Remote.
We collaborate with teams around the Globe and our HQ in Berlin, where the Berlin team often meets in the office.

You have 4+ years managing technical projects or solution delivery, including in a consulting or high growth environment
You are confident navigating technical topics like API integrations, architecture diagrams, and e-commerce, even if you’re not the one coding.
You’re a structured communicator who can translate complexity into clarity for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
You take ownership, thrive in ambiguity, and are energised by solving cross-functional coordination challenges.
You are business fluent in English and Spanish, both written and spoken.
You are open to business travel to our key markets in Latin America.

You will join a fast-paced travel tech company and take on a rapidly growing industry.
You will take on ownership and responsibility from day one and directly impact the company's success.
We value agility! We’re constantly updating our tech stack and offer the best possible tools to ensure all of our in-house engineers, partners, and carriers benefit from cutting-edge, efficient solutions.
You will work with global companies. Our product attracts the biggest names in travel technology, such as Booking.com and Google Maps, and national carriers like Amtrak, Deutsche Bahn, Renfe, and SNCF.
You will join an international team of talented and driven people with a clear mission. Expect your colleagues to inspire, support and challenge you every day!
We offer flexible and remote working conditions, relocation opportunities and career growth in a small and developing company.

Die dokSAFE GmbH ist ein Leipziger Softwareunternehmen, das sich auf die Entwicklung der SaaS-Lösung ACTAPORT spezialisiert hat. Wir arbeiten gemeinsam daran, mit unserer Kanzleisoftware die Arbeitswelt in der Anwaltskanzlei zu revolutionieren.
Du liebst es, komplexe Projekte von der Konzeption bis zum Go-live zu steuern — und dabei sowohl Entwickler:innen als auch C-Level-Entscheider:innen auf Kurs zu halten? Dann suchen wir genau DICH! Als Senior IT Project Manager (m/w/d) übernimmst Du die End-to-End-Verantwortung für unsere strategischen Produkt- und Kundenprojekte.

Du bist die Schnittstelle zwischen Business, Entwicklung und externen Partnern — und treibst dabei sowohl operative Exzellenz als auch die Skalierung von ACTAPORT aktiv voran.
Aufgaben
Du leitest eigenverantwortlich komplexe Software-Implementierungsprojekte von der Konzeption bis zum Go-live und stellst dabei Qualität, Zeitplan und Budget sicher.
Du baust crossfunktionale Projektteams aus Entwicklung, Legal, Sales und Customer Success auf und führst diese durch alle Projektphasen.
Du begleitest Kanzleien und Rechtsabteilungen eng bei der Einführung unserer Lösungen — inklusive Change Management und nachhaltiger Nutzerakzeptanz.
Du definierst und überwachst KPIs, Meilensteine und Budgets, erkennst Risiken frühzeitig und steuerst proaktiv gegen.
Du identifizierst Prozessverbesserungen und Skalierungspotenziale und gestaltest unsere PM-Methodik aktiv mit.
Du baust langfristige Kundenbeziehungen auf und berätst Stakeholder auf C-Level mit dem Ziel nachhaltiger Partnerschaften.
Qualifikation

Sie übernehmen Verantwortung für laufende Bauvorhaben im Bereich MSR und Gebäudeautomation. Dabei steuern und koordinieren Sie Mitarbeitende, Nachunternehmer, Material und Abläufe und sorgen dafür, dass Qualität, Termine und Ergebnisse zusammenpassen.

Nos prestations couvrent l'ensemble du cycle de vie des bâtiments, sites, infrastructures et quartiers.

En tant que leader du marché, nos clients bénéficient d'une gamme complète de services auprès d'un seul interlocuteur ainsi que de solutions à leurs projets élaborées de façon intégrée et en équipe. Nous disposons d'une présence dans toute la Suisse et employons 6500 personnes réparties sur 140 sites.

Cela nous permet de mettre en œuvre efficacement des projets aussi bien régionaux que couvrant tout le pays.

Outre la technique et l'automation des bâtiments ainsi que le Facility Management, notre offre comprend également des spécialisations telles que l'approvisionnement en énergie, les transports, les télécommunications, la numérisation et l'optimisation énergétique.

Nous concevons, construisons et réalisons ainsi des projets qui s'étendent de bâtiments intelligents à des centrales électriques d'avenir en passant par des tunnels.

Do you excel at turning complexity into clarity? Are you energized by shaping the customer journey and guest experience aboard our new ships?
We are looking for a Newbuild Experience Development & Delivery Manager to join our team, reporting to the Senior Manager, Experience Development & Delivery.
This role is designed for someone who can cut through complexity, uncover the real challenges behind ambiguous situations, and reframe them into guest-centric experiences that can be brought to life within the physical environment of our ships. You are able to connect customer needs, operational realities, and business objectives, transforming ideas into clear, actionable concepts and deliverables.
Working closely with stakeholders across Hotel Operations, F&B, Entertainment, Retail, Marketing, Newbuild, Architecture, and Design, you will help define, develop, and deliver future guest experiences from concept through execution. * Participate in or lead selected meetings on behalf of Guest Experience Innovation.
* Prepare strategic briefs, decision frameworks, and synthesis documents for înternal conversations.
**Narrative Building & Deliverables Presentation**

* Transform complex information into high-impact narratives.
**Cross-Functional Collaboration**
* Engage with Hotel Operations, F&B, Entertainment, Retail, Marketing, Newbuild, Architects, and Designers teams to gather insights and shape concepts.
* Lead the development and delivery of new entertainment concepts, experiences, and spaces across our fleet.
* Act as the key link between creative partners, operations, and corporate functions, ensuring alignment and buy-in at every stage.

* Experience in hospitality, cruise, retail, consumer goods, or guest experience is a strong plus.
* Strong background in designing and executing guest-focused experiences, from concept to delivery.
* A balance of creativity and operational know-how, able to dream big and deliver practically.
* Proven track record in managing complex, cross-functional teams (operations, creative, marketing, sales, revenue, communications), with the ability to unite diverse perspectives around a single vision.

The Principal Project Manager is a senior delivery leader within Professional Services, responsible for the rigor, predictability, and outcomes of Cyara ’s implementation and services portfolio.

Reporting to the Senior Director, Professional Services, this is a player-coach role: you will personally own a portfolio of complex, strategic customer engagements while leading and developing a small team of Project Managers supporting customers across North America, EMEA, and APAC.

You will set the standard for how Professional Services plans, governs, reports on, and closes out customer projects — bringing PMO discipline to a global delivery organization.

Portfolio Leadership & Delivery Execution
Own a portfolio of complex, multi-phase, and strategic customer implementations and services engagements from initiation through formal completion and closure.
Lead and coach a small team of Project Managers, setting expectations, reviewing project plans, and holding the team accountable to consistent delivery standards.
Personally manage select high-value or high-complexity accounts, staying close to delivery while building the team’s ability to do the same.
Project Governance & PMO Standards
Establish consistent project-management standards, templates, and methodologies across Professional Services, covering planning, resource forecasting, effort estimation, and change control.
Define governance for complex, multi-phase, recurring, and long-duration programs, including clear criteria for closing individual phases and full projects instead of leaving them administratively open.
Build the risk management, dependency tracking, and executive escalation practices that keep engagements on track and stakeholders informed.
Cross-Functional Partnership & Executive Communication
Partner with Professional Services leadership, consultants, technical resources, Sales, and Customer Success to align delivery plans with customer commitments and business priorities.
Serve as the executive point of contact for project status, risk, and escalation on strategic accounts, communicating directly with customer sponsors and internal leadership.
Build feedback checkpoints at meaningful delivery milestones so customer satisfaction is measured throughout an engagement, not only at its conclusion.
Reporting, Financial Performance & Continuous Improvement
Own project health, milestone, budget, hours, and utilization reporting, using Rocketlane or a comparable PSA platform to give leadership real-time visibility into the portfolio.
Track forecast accuracy, time-to-value, and financial performance across the portfolio, and correct course when projects drift from plan.
Identify systemic delivery risks from portfolio data, recommend process changes, and build the playbooks, templates, and dashboards that let the PMO function scale.

Delivery Leadership & Project Management Experience
Significant experience managing complex enterprise technology implementations or Professional Services engagements, including multiple concurrent projects or portfolios.
Experience leading and developing Project Managers, with the ability and willingness to personally manage projects while also providing team leadership.
Strong executive customer communication and escalation-management skills, gained working directly with customer sponsors and internal leadership on complex engagements.
PMO & Project Management Discipline
Demonstrated ability to build or mature PMO processes: templates, governance standards, reporting, and delivery methodology.
Strong understanding of PMI-aligned project-management disciplines, including planning, risk, scope, and change management.
Experience managing project financials — budgets, hours, forecasts, and change requests — and resource plans across a portfolio of engagements.
Experience working across global, cross-functional organizations spanning multiple regions and time zones.
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in business, information technology, or a related field.

Experience with Rocketlane, Salesforce, or comparable PSA platforms preferred.
SaaS, enterprise software, CX, CCaaS, telecommunications, testing/automation, or related technology experience preferred.
Why This Role
You’ll bring PMO rigor to a global Professional Services organization, shaping how Cyara plans, governs, and closes customer engagements across North America, EMEA, and APAC.
You’ll operate as both a player and a coach — owning strategic accounts directly while building the standards and capability of a growing Project Management team.
You’ll report to the Senior Director, Professional Services, and partner closely with Professional Services leadership, Sales, and Customer Success to improve time-to-value, financial performance, and customer satisfaction across the portfolio.

Senior Program Manager, Data Security & Information Governance
Why We Have This Role
We’re hiring a Senior Program Manager, Data Security & Information Governance to establish, scale, and orchestrate our enterprise Information Governance program. You’ll sit at the intersection of Legal, Data & Technology Operations, and Enterprise Data, bridging the gap between business strategy, legal compliance, data security, and engineering.

Rather than acting as a traditional gatekeeper, you will build and manage our "Data Front Door" to directly address how teams discover data rights, request entitlements, and explore novel data use cases safely and efficiently.
How You’ll Find Success
Governance Framework & Tooling Strategy: Deep fluency in establishing enterprise data governance frameworks, data catalogs, and business glossaries that scale across high-growth SaaS environments.
Operational Enablement: Proven capability to design centralized intake and triage processes ("Data Front Door") that convert complex legal and security constraints into frictionless, self-service internal workflows.
Cross-Functional Alignment: Ability to bridge legal compliance (HIPAA, GDPR, CCPA) with technical access controls (RBAC/ABAC, tokenization), working seamlessly alongside engineering, security, and product teams.
Proactive Execution: Takes initiative to define the "how" in ambiguous regulatory or operational spaces, driving cross-functional alignment and resolving data policy conflicts across teams.
Adaptive Curiosity: A drive to stay ahead of evolving data privacy laws, security architectures, and novel AI/ML data use cases to keep our governance models modern and flexible.
How You’ll Grow
Master Enterprise Data Architecture: Expand your expertise across cloud data architectures (Snowflake, Databricks, AWS/GCP) and automated metadata pipelines to build modern, tech-enabled governance structures.
Bridge Legal and Engineering Operations: Deepen your technical competency in access management (Okta, Immuta, Privacera) and data security capabilities, dissolving the divide between legal strategy and technical execution.
Influence Platform Scale: Set the patterns and primitives for data use across a platform serving 18K+ global clients, ensuring data minimization, privacy-by-design, and compliant AI experimentation.
Things You’ll Do
Build the "Data Front Door": Design and manage a centralized intake and triage process for custom data access requests, novel data questions, and complex derivative work inquiries.
Curate the Data Marketplace: Establish a centralized Use Case Repository and Data Marketplace detailing pre-approved data uses, restrictions, and licensing parameters across distinct datasets.
Automate Metadata & Classification: Partner with engineering and security teams to implement automated data classification, lineage tracking, and metadata harvesting.
Translate Policy into Technical Controls: Collaborate with InfoSec to operationalize legal requirements into enforced technical access controls (RBAC/ABAC) and row/column-level security protocols.
Drive Governance Adoption: Measure program success through adoption KPIs, request turnaround times, and governance maturity metrics, delivering self-service documentation and onboarding across the org.

s.h: What We’re Looking For On Your Resume
s.t:
5+ years of experience in Data Governance, Data Security, Data Operations, or Information Architecture within a high-growth technology, SaaS, or data-intensive organization.
Deep understanding of data privacy and security frameworks (HIPAA, GDPR, CCPA) and commercial data licensing nuances.
Direct experience setting up, configuring, or administering enterprise data governance & catalog tools (e.g., Collibra, Alation, DataGalaxy, Atlan).
Technical aptitude with cloud data ecosystems (Snowflake, Databricks, AWS/GCP), SQL, and data security mechanisms (hashing, tokenization, differential privacy).
Demonstrated ability to create business-friendly, self-service workflows that accelerate R&D and AI/ML initiatives while ensuring strict compliance.
Preferred certifications: CDMP, CIPP/US, CIPT, CDPSE, CISSP, or CISM.
What You Should Know About This Team
Enablement Over Gatekeeping: We view governance as a business driver. Our goal is to make doing the right thing with data the easiest path for our product, engineering, and business teams.
Cross-Functional Influence: You will sit at the crossroads of Legal, InfoSec, and Platform Engineering, serving as the connective tissue that translates legal policies into automated technical realities.
Built for Scale: As Qualtrics expands its AI and data capabilities, you will build the foundational governance frameworks that ensure our growth remains safe, ethical, and fully compliant.
Why you’ll want to join us: Most design teams are talking about AI; we are the ones building the engine that powers it. If you want to bridge the gap between design and development, thrive in high-autonomy environments, and see your code directly power intelligent experiences for 18K+ global clients, this is the place to be. We don’t just design the future—we code it, test it, and ship it.

In unserer Zentrale arbeiten rund **150 Spezialistinnen und Spezialisten** aus den Bereichen IT, HR, Marketing und Finanzen Hand in Hand, um gemeinsam **innovative Lösungen** zu entwickeln und unsere Unternehmensziele zu erreichen.
Mit **flexiblen Arbeitsplätzen** und modernen **Meeting Pods** fördern wir eine **offene und effiziente Arbeitskultur**. Bei Medbase legen wir grossen Wert auf **Teamarbeit** und den Austausch zwischen den Abteilungen, um gemeinsam erfolgreich zu sein.
Hier treffen sich Kolleginnen und Kollegen aus unseren Schwesterunternehmen wie Zur Rose, WePractice oder dem Zahnarztzentrum, was den **interdisziplinären Austausch** weiter bereichert.

Das kannst du bei uns bewegen
* **Führung wirksam gestalten**: Du entwickelst Geschäftsführungen deiner Region weiter, stärkst ihre Führungskompetenz und leistest wichtige Beiträge für leistungsfähige Teams.

Relevante Kennzahlen und identifizierte Hebel helfen dir dabei, Potenziale zu erkennen, die richtigen Prioritäten zu setzen und gemeinsam mit den Standorten nachhaltige Ergebnisse zu erzielen.
* **Apotheke und Kundenerlebnis weiterentwickeln**: Mit einem klaren Fokus auf die Bedürfnisse unserer Kunden stärkst du Beratung und Service, entwickelst das pharmazeutisch-medizinische Angebot weiter und sorgst für attraktive, leistungsfähige Standorte. Gemeinsam mit den zentralen Fachbereichen sowie den Standorten bringst du strategische Initiativen erfolgreich in die Umsetzung.
* **Veränderung und Wachstum gestalten**: Du beobachtest das lokale Marktumfeld, erkennst Chancen und Entwicklungen frühzeitig und gestaltest Veränderungen aktiv. Dabei begleitest du die erfolgreiche Integration neuer Standorte und stellst sicher, dass neue Impulse nachhaltig an den Standorten und in deiner Region Wirkung entfalten.
Was du mitbringst
* **Aus- und Weiterbildung**: Du bringst eine höhere Aus- oder Weiterbildung in Betriebswirtschaft, Detailhandel, Gesundheitswesen, Pharmazie oder einer vergleichbaren Richtung mit.
* **Marktkenntnis**: Du kennst den Schweizer Apothekenmarkt sehr fundiert aus der Praxis und verstehst seine regulatorischen Rahmenbedingungen sowie die relevanten wirtschaftlichen Hebel.
* **Führungskompetenz**: Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Führung von dezentralen oder filialisierten Organisationen zeichnet dich aus. Führungskräfte entwickelst du klar, verbindlich und wertschätzend.

* **Unternehmerisches Denken**: Kennzahlen und betriebswirtschaftliche Zusammenhänge sowie Affinität zu Marketing und Verkauf sind für dich wichtige Entscheidungsgrundlagen. Daraus leitest du Prioritäten und konkrete Massnahmen ab.

## About Our Client ##
Unser Kunde ist ein führendes internationales Handels- und Distributionsunternehmen mit einem schweizweiten Netzwerk und einer starken Marktposition. Dank hoher Serviceorientierung, moderner Logistiklösungen und einer ausgeprägten Kundennähe zählt das Unternehmen zu den etablierten Akteuren seiner Branche.
## Job Description ##
* Weiterentwicklung und Umsetzung einer nationalen Warehouse-Strategie in einem komplexen Distributionsumfeld

* Erfahrung im Grosshandel, in Distributionsnetzwerken oder vergleichbaren logistischen Umfeldern von Vorteil
## What's on Offer ##
* Schlüsselrolle mit direktem Einfluss auf die Weiterentwicklung einer nationalen Warehouse-Organisation
* Möglichkeit, Prozesse, Standards und Führungsstrukturen nachhaltig mitzugestalten
* Modernes Umfeld mit Fokus auf Operational Excellence, kontinuierliche Verbesserung und langfristige Entwicklung

Join the FIA and lead a pioneering safety technology programme.
As F1 Augmented Reality Project Manager within the FIA Technical Department, you will lead a strategic multi-year programme exploring how Augmented Reality and Head-Up Display technologies could enhance driver safety and situational awareness, particularly in conditions of reduced visibility.
You will act as the programme’s technical leader and systems integrator, coordinating specialised suppliers, research partners, Formula 1 teams and internal FIA stakeholders.
This is not a traditional project management role. It requires the technical knowledge to challenge engineering proposals, manage integration risks and drive complex technical decisions.
This new permanent, full-time position is based in Geneva.

Technical programme leadership
Define and own the multi-year technical roadmap, development phases, milestones and deliverables.
Structure the programme across key technologies, including helmet and visor displays, optical HUD solutions, sensors, vehicle positioning, data processing and sensor fusion.
Lead the programme from technology assessment and proof of concept through prototype development, integration and testing.
Maintain effective governance through risk, dependency, resource and milestone management.
Systems integration and technical coordination
Act as the technical systems integrator across on-car electronics, sensors, communication systems, data-processing solutions and driver equipment.
Translate safety and operational objectives into technical requirements, system architectures and validation plans.
Identify technical dependencies, interface constraints and integration risks across hardware and software systems.
Ensure that solutions address Formula 1 constraints, including packaging, weight, aerodynamics, cooling, latency, reliability and driver safety.
Supplier and stakeholder management
Identify and coordinate specialised technology suppliers, engineering partners and research organisations.
Review and challenge supplier proposals, technical architectures, test results, costs and delivery timelines.
Build alignment across Formula 1 teams, FIA technical departments, safety specialists and external partners.
Lead technical workshops, reconcile competing requirements and facilitate pragmatic compromises.
Testing, human factors and risk management
Coordinate simulation, laboratory evaluation, prototype development and vehicle-based testing.
Develop validation protocols for individual technologies and integrated solutions.
Assess human factors, including cognitive workload, visual ergonomics, information prioritisation, latency and emergency driver egress.
Identify and mitigate technical, safety, financial, intellectual property and programme-delivery risks.
Regulatory and strategic roadmap
Assess potential implications for FIA Technical, Sporting and Financial Regulations.
Support the development of regulatory, standardisation and implementation roadmaps.
Prepare technical trade-off analyses, recommendations and phased implementation scenarios.
Consolidate technical findings and test results into clear reports for senior leadership and governance bodies.

Master’s degree in Systems Engineering, Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Control Engineering, Embedded Systems, Avionics, Optronics or a related discipline.
Minimum 7 to 10 years of relevant engineering and project management experience involving complex electronic, control or safety-critical systems.
Strong technical knowledge across areas such as vehicle electronics, control systems, sensors, communication systems, sensor fusion, positioning technologies, embedded systems or optical displays.
Experience in Formula 1, WEC or advanced motorsport. Relevant experience from aerospace, avionics or advanced automotive engineering is also welcomed.
Proven experience coordinating complex engineering programmes involving multiple suppliers and interconnected technical workstreams.
Experience integrating hardware and software components within demanding, high-performance or safety-critical environments.
Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to reconcile competing technical priorities.
Experience with HUD technologies, helmet systems, sensor fusion, vehicle positioning or driver-assistance technologies would be an advantage.
Full professional proficiency in English.
If you are interested, please send your application in PDF format.
The FIA is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce. We welcome and encourage applications from all qualified candidates.

s.t:
Ashley Digital is the e-commerce engine behind Ashley Furniture Industries — one of the most recognized home brands in the world. As the world's largest manufacturer of home furnishings and the largest furniture store brand in North America, Ashley is in a category unto itself.

Our team sits at the intersection of world-class retail and digital innovation, driving the e-commerce experience for millions of customers across every platform and touchpoint. If you’ve shopped online for a mattress in the last decade, there’s a good chance you’ve already experienced our award-winning Nectar Sleep and DreamCloud.
